strategy.title: One Fact About the Universe That Sounds Wrong—but Isn't
strategy.hook: The most useful fact about the observable universe initially feels like it should be impossible.

story_structure.opening: Show the common assumption about the observable universe as a simple visual prediction.
story_structure.escalation: Reveal the contradictory evidence in two clear steps, then explain why intuition fails.
story_structure.takeaway: Close with the corrected mental model viewers will want to repeat to someone else.

strategy.audience: Curious learners who save and share clear visual explanations.
strategy.visual_direction: Split-screen misconception versus reality for the observable universe; strong central contrast, one visual reveal, evidence markers, editorial before-and-after composition
